values: Galicia options: what the data says
21 Aug–16 Sep 2026. October expiry. ARS per share unless stated. Historical estimates, not executable quotes.
920 observations, 50 series, 19 dates. Calls and puts share one expiry.
The added Closing price column refers to next-row openingPrice. It is excluded.
658 IV estimates retained. Zero-volume and inconsistent-range rows are excluded.
30% continuous rate and zero dividends are assumptions. Daily table includes 20% / 40% rate checks.
Raw-volume ratio measures this file only. Volume units and market-wide coverage are unverified.
Compare historical costs and payoff shapes. Negative butterfly costs are data flags, not proven arbitrage.
No bid/ask, OI or second expiry. Nineteen dates cannot support a 1-year IV rank.
Quality counts overlap. Screened prices can still be stale or asynchronous.
IV describes model-implied future uncertainty; RV measures past share-price variability.
Buy the two wings and sell two middle-strike options. Peak expiration P&L is at the middle strike.
Buy one option and sell two further out-of-the-money options. Premium income adds tail exposure.
16 Sep prices. Buy 1 call at 6,600, sell 2 at 6,800, buy 1 at 7,000. All expiration outcomes exclude costs.

values: Matched to saved BYMA September 7 option metadata.
30% annual continuous rate, illustrative constant; not an observed funding curve.
q = 0 assumption; no verified forward dividend schedule.
Standard BYMA share-option lot. Check extraordinary corporate adjustments.
Realized volatility uses sample standard deviation of daily log returns.
Illustrative rate sensitivity; same model, spot and option price.
Equivalent to American call under the stated non-dividend assumption.
29 bisections, bounded 0–500% IV; rejects unstable/intrinsic-bound prices.
No security-master strike adjustments verified. All outputs conditional on this mapping.
No use of next-row opening price as a close. No bid/ask spread information.
P/C raw-volume ratio is NOT a verified contract-count ratio. May be monetary turnover.
Also rejects below-intrinsic prices and model-bound violations. Not proof of a fresh quote.
Re-run analysis after changing inputs. Editing assumptions here does not recompute IV.
Using estimated IV. Vega is ARS per share per 1 percentage-point IV change.
Average call/put IV at that strike. Strike can change; tenor declines. Not constant maturity.
Linear interpolation by BS delta, no extrapolation. American-put delta is approximated.
Smile curvature, distinct from the 1:-2:1 price strategy.
Backward RV and forward IV cover different periods; gap is not guaranteed excess return.
Excludes fees, financing, slippage and early-assignment cash flows. Multiply by 100 per standard set.
One long lower-strike call and two short higher-strike calls.
One long higher-strike put and two short lower-strike puts. Downside bound assumes spot >= 0.
No OI, quotes or second expiry. No full-year IV rank or percentile from 19 days.
Stock: MarketData/Search, GGAL, ACCIONES, A-24HS, June 1–September 16, 2026.
